review.editorial: Reviewed the full shared-room scene for natural banter and room for independent choices. Added the physical test referent and its on-page action rather than leaving the reader to infer what catches.
review.continuity_or_facts: Corrected an independent appointment’s date against the departure calendar; checked the earlier draft letter and its actual handoff without claiming delivery. Prototype, original object and finished part remain distinct.
review.english_alignment: Reviewed sentence-sized translations, negation, speaker references and word spans. Contextual counting, tool and particle readings have regression coverage; all phone and desktop samples have readable guide text.

samples.notes: Phone pinyin opening: source and English remain legible through the first sentence and transition, with readable colours and punctuation.
Phone character middle: dialogue/narration wrap with meaningful English beneath the source lines, without visible clipping.
Phone character ending: the closing source fragment and corresponding English are visible above the footer; no English-free paragraph unit.
Desktop pinyin middle: inspected word spacing, punctuation and English wrapping in the actual reader; guides remain readable.
